capabilities: Wrap selected text in <sup> or <sub> tags via hotkeys
Toggle persistent superscript or subscript typing mode
Remove existing sup and sub tags from a selection
Show a selection popup with Sup, Sub, and Normal buttons
Hide sup/sub tags so only styled text is visible
extras: README details platform-specific hotkeys (macOS and Windows), a configurable popup modifier key, and a 'Hide Tags' setting; no screenshots or examples beyond step-by-step workflows.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands or UI for quickly applying superscript and subscript formatting to selected text.
summary: Formatting plugin that wraps selected text in <sup> and <sub> tags and toggles superscript/subscript typing modes via hotkeys or popup buttons.
